features.feature: Every in-scope Codex/Claude implementer, verification-intent compatibility, topology-critic, concept, quality, coverage, docs and delivery prompt carries lane-appropriate canonical rollout guidance and cannot become authority
Verifier-owned versioned rollout report derives aggregates and rejects caller membership, verdict and aggregate fields
Real reproducible cohort freezes verifier-derived eligibility rule, evaluation window and complete eligible membership with at least three matched pairs and at least three cases per arm
Cohort mutations reject omitted eligible rows, added ineligible rows, window/membership/order/digest drift and insufficient paired/arm cardinality
Report receipt binds eligibility, full frozen membership, source rows, version, workspace hashes, cost, rounds, waivers, adapters and full-3x2 provenance
Docs-only, legacy and ordinary single-outcome controls measure zero supported false blocks without fabricated runtime proof
Every registered seeded defect class must have overall false-pass rate 0, supported omission detection 100%, and incomplete campaigns or non-omission misses fail closed
Flat thresholds additionally require zero false blocks and mislabeled 3x1, nonpositive waiver delta, nonshrinking checks, supported adapters and at least three matched samples in each arm
Unknown, partial, unsupported, incomplete-campaign, membership-drift or disagreeing adapters/campaigns fail promotion deterministically
Opt-in enforce mechanically consumes the exact current signed PASS report receipt at CLI and lifecycle consumers
Enforcement requires genuine current three rounds across two independent supported hosts and degraded 3x1 is never authority
Missing, stale, tampered, failing or weakened report/quorum/threshold inputs fail closed at the real consumer with stable codes
Rollback changes blocking policy only and preserves reports, receipts, transitions, diagnostics and evidence history
Canonical Story 6 plan and CLI docs update only after executable cohort/enforcement/rollback proof, with exact measured results and commands
Selective per-Story/per-policy enforcement remains excluded until Wave 3A is implemented
features.excluded_by: Wave 3A is explicitly skipped for flat rollout and remains mandatory before selective applicability can be claimed.
